description: Selection, movement and scrolling (§6.4), the defaults of the session (§5.2) and the form commands give it (§6.1).

cases.description: The cell becomes the active cell, anchor, focus and the only range; the active cell has the key of its loaded row.
extend changes the last range only.
Extending a range of whole rows keeps whole rows.
With extend, only `to` counts: focus moves to it, in the active row.
Moving without extend moves from the active cell and makes it the only range.
page moves by context.page rows (3 here).
Tab walks through the range and the selection stays.
Enter walks down the column, then to the top of the next one.
Shift+Tab from the first cell wraps to the last one.
Enter at the last row of whole columns wraps to the first row of the next column.
A row the core has not read gives the active cell no key.
In a view without rows, positions are 0.
Absent members: the active cell is the first row and the first displayed column, and anchor, focus and the selection are the active cell.
Columns pinned left come first, in the order of columns: note, qty, id, region, …
